biotools.summary: WEPP is a pathogen-agnostic pipeline for wastewater-based epidemiology that enhances resolution by incorporating comprehensive phylogenetic placement of sequencing reads into mutation-annotated trees. It reports haplotype abundance, lineages, and unaccounted alleles, providing insights into emerging variants.
